jobs.title: Lean Specialist (m/w/d) - Process Improvement
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid or Onsite

Gestalten Sie aktiv die Zukunft der Produktion mit: In dieser Rolle treiben Sie die systematische Weiterentwicklung von Lean Management voran und verankern nachhaltige Verbesserungen im gesamten Werk. Sie schaffen messbaren Mehrwert durch effiziente Prozesse, klare Führungssysteme und eine starke Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

Unser Angebot an Sie

• Leiten und implementieren Lean-Initiativen und Kaizen-Workshops in Produktions- und Supportbereichen und sichern messbare Verbesserungen von Durchlaufzeiten, Qualität und Produktivität

• Standardisieren und stabilisieren Shopfloor-Management- und KPI-Strukturen zur transparenten Steuerung der Performance

• Coachen Führungskräfte und Teams in Problemlösungsmethoden und sorgen für die konsequente Anwendung strukturierter Verbesserungsprozesse

• Analysieren Wertströme und führen Workshops zur Identifikation und Reduktion von Verschwendung durch

• Integrieren Leader Standard Work in die tägliche Führung und etablieren regelmässige Reviews zur Sicherstellung der Umsetzung

• Verfolgen Verbesserungsmassnahmen systematisch nach und stellen nachhaltige Ergebnisse anhand klarer Kennzahlen sicher

• Unterstützen die Digitalisierung von Lean-Elementen durch Einführung von visuellen und datenbasierten Lösungen (z. B. digitale Dashboards)

• Fördern aktiv eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch Trainings, Schulungen und praxisnahe Umsetzung am Arbeitsplatz

• Führen die Implementierung des Stryker Production Systems (SPS) und stellen durch Training, Coaching und Begleitung die nachhaltige Anwendung von Lean-Tools und -Methoden sicher.

• Agieren als Stellvertretung des Lean Managers und übernehmen bei Bedarf die fachliche Führung und Koordination standortweiter Lean- und Continuous-Improvement-Aktivitäten.

Das zeichnet Sie aus
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Studienabschluss HF oder FH (Bachelor oder Master) in Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Industrial Engineering, Fertigungstechnik, Supply Chain Management, Prozessmanagement und Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Minimum 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung von Lean-Projekten im Produktionsumfeld

• Nachweisbare Kenntnisse in Lean-Methoden (z. B. Wertstromanalyse, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, TPM, PDCA)

• Erfahrung im Einsatz von MS365, Power Automate und Power BI

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

• Englisch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Zertifizierung im Lean- oder Prozessmanagement (z. B. Lean Management, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt oder Yellow Belt)

• Erfahrung mit digitalen Visualisierungs- und Kollaborationstools (z. B. Miro)

• Kenntnisse in Layoutgestaltung und Materialflussanalyse

Additional Information

• Arbeitsort: Produktionsumfeld im Werk

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Produktion, Qualität, Engineering, Logistik)

• Gelegentliche bereichsübergreifende Einsätze und Mitwirkung bei Audits möglich

Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu gestalten und operative Exzellenz messbar voranzutreiben – mit direktem Einfluss auf die Performance des gesamten Standorts.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen ungeachtet ihrer ethnischen, nationalen oder sozialen Herkunft, des Geschlechts, einer Behinderung, des Alters oder ihrer sexuellen Identität.

Ihre Bewerbung
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und inklusive aller relevanten Dokumente (Anschreiben, aktueller Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, ggf. Arbeitserlaubnis). Laden Sie bitte unter dem Punkt „Lebenslauf“ alle Anhänge direkt hoch.

Progettare attivamente il futuro della produzione: in questo ruolo, si spinge avanti lo sviluppo sistematico della gestione snella e ancorare miglioramenti sostenibili in tutto l'impianto. Essi creano valore aggiunto misurabile attraverso processi efficienti, sistemi di gestione chiari e una forte cultura di miglioramento continuo.

La nostra offerta per voi

- Guida e attuazione di iniziative snelle e workshop Kaizen nelle aree di produzione e di sostegno e garantire miglioramenti misurabili nei tempi di produzione, qualità e produttività
- Standardizzare e stabilizzare la gestione del pavimento dei negozi e le strutture KPI per un controllo trasparente delle prestazioni
- Coaching manager e team in metodi di risoluzione dei problemi e garantire l'applicazione coerente dei processi di miglioramento strutturato
- Analisi dei flussi di valore e workshop di condotta sull'identificazione e la riduzione dei rifiuti
- Leader Leader Standard di INTEGRE Lavorare nella leadership quotidiana e stabilire revisioni periodiche per garantire l'attuazione
- Seguire sistematicamente le misure di miglioramento e garantire risultati sostenibili utilizzando indicatori chiari
- Sostenere la digitalizzazione degli elementi snelli introducendo soluzioni visive e basate sui dati (ad esempio Dashboard digitali)
- Promuovere attivamente una cultura di miglioramento continuo attraverso la formazione, la formazione e l'attuazione pratica sul luogo di lavoro
- Eseguire l'implementazione del sistema di produzione Stryker (SPS) e garantire l'applicazione sostenibile di strumenti e metodi snelli attraverso la formazione, l'allenamento e il supporto.
- Agire come rappresentante del Lean Manager e assumere la gestione professionale e il coordinamento delle attività di miglioramento snello e continuo, se necessario.

Ecco cosa ti fa sentire.
Qualificazioni richieste

- Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Industriale, Ingegneria Manifatturiera, Gestione Supply Chain, Gestione del Processo e Informatica Business (HF) o FH (Bachelor o Master)
- Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nella pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti snelli nel contesto produttivo
- Rilevamento di metodi snelli (ad esempio analisi del flusso di valore, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, TPM, PDCA)
- Esperienza nell'utilizzo di MS65, Power Automate e Power BI
- Tedesco a livello nativo
- Inglese a livello negoziale

Qualificazioni preferite

- Certificazione di Lean o di gestione dei processi (ad esempio, Lean Management, Lean Six Sigium Green Belt o Yellow Belt)
- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione digitale e collaborazione (ad es.Miro)
- Conoscenza nella progettazione del layout e analisi del flusso di materiali

Informazioni supplementari

- Luogo di lavoro: Ambiente di produzione in fabbrica
- Stretto coordinamento con i team interfunzionali (produzione, qualità, ingegneria, logistica)
- Possibilità di operazioni trasversali occasionali e partecipazione agli audit

Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di modellare cambiamenti sostenibili e di guidare l'eccellenza operativa in modo misurabile. con un impatto diretto sulle prestazioni dell'intera location.

La diversità è importante per noi
Siamo lieti di ricevere richieste da persone indipendentemente dal loro background etnico, nazionale o sociale, sesso, disabilità, età o identità sessuale.

La tua domanda
Siamo lieti di ricevere la tua valida applicazione online, inclusi tutti i documenti pertinenti (lettera, CV attuale, certificati, permesso di lavoro se applicabile). Si prega di caricare tutti gli allegati direttamente sotto la voce "Curriculum Vitae."

Se hai già un permesso di lavoro, ti chiediamo di caricare il tipo esatto di permesso con la tua applicazione.

Si prega di notare che il titolo dell'annuncio può differire dal titolo interno del lavoro.

Work flexibility: Hybrid or Onsite

Actively shape the future of production: In this role, you drive forward the systematic development of lean management and anchor sustainable improvements throughout the plant. They create measurable added value through efficient processes, clear management systems and a strong culture of continuous improvement.

Our offer to you

- Guide and implement lean initiatives and Kaizen workshops in production and support areas and ensure measurable improvements in throughput times, quality and productivity
- Standardize and stabilize shop floor-level management and KPI structures for transparent control of performance
- Coaching managers and teams in problem solving methods and ensure the consistent application of structured improvement processes
- Analyse value streams and conduct workshops on identification and reduction of waste
- Integrate Leader Standard Work into daily leadership and establish regular reviews to ensure implementation
- Track improvement measures systematically and ensure sustainable results using clear indicators
- Support the digitalization of lean elements by introducing visual and data-based solutions (e.g. digital Dashboards)
- Actively promote a culture of continuous improvement through training, training and practical implementation at the workplace
- Perform the implementation of the Stryker Production System (SPS) and ensure the sustainable application of lean tools and methods through training, coaching and support.
- Act as a representative of the Lean Manager and take over the professional management and coordination of lean and Continual improvement activities if necessary.

That's what makes you feel
Required qualifications

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Process Management and Business Informatics (HF) or FH (Bachelor or Master)
- Minimum 3 years of experience in planning and implementing lean projects in the production environment
- Detection of lean methods (e.g. value stream analysis, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, TPM, PDCA)
- Experience in the use of MS65, Power Automate and Power BI
- German at a native level
- English at a negotiating level

Preferred qualifications

- Lean or process management certification (e.g. Lean Management, Lean Six Sigium Green Belt or Yellow Belt)
- Experience with digital visualization and collaboration tools (e.g. Miro)
- Knowledge in layout design and material flow analysis

Additional information

- Place of work: Production environment in the factory
- Close cooperation with cross-functional teams (production, quality, engineering, logistics)
- Occasional cross-cutting operations and participation in audits possible

This position offers the opportunity to shape sustainable changes and to drive operational excellence in a measurable way – with a direct impact on the performance of the entire location.

Diversity is important to us
We are pleased to receive applications from people regardless of their ethnic, national or social background, gender, disability, age or sexual identity.

Your application
We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application, including all relevant documents (letter, current CV, certificates, work permit if applicable). Please upload all attachments directly under the item "Curriculum Vitae".

If you already have a work permit, we ask you to upload the exact type of permit with your application.

Please note that the ad title may differ from the internal job title.

Formez activement l'avenir de la production : Dans ce rôle, vous propulsez le développement systématique de la gestion maigre et ancrez des améliorations durables dans l'ensemble de l'usine. Elles créent une valeur ajoutée mesurable grâce à des processus efficaces, des systèmes de gestion clairs et une solide culture d'amélioration continue.

Notre offre à vous

- Guider et mettre en œuvre des initiatives de maigres et des ateliers de Kaizen dans les domaines de la production et de l'appui et assurer des améliorations mesurables dans les délais de livraison, la qualité et la productivité
- Normaliser et stabiliser la gestion au niveau des ateliers et les structures de l'ICP pour un contrôle transparent des performances
- Coaching des gestionnaires et des équipes dans les méthodes de résolution de problèmes et assurer l'application cohérente des processus d'amélioration structurés
- Analyser les flux de valeur et organiser des ateliers sur l'identification et la réduction des déchets
- Intégrer le travail standard de Leader dans le leadership quotidien et établir des examens réguliers pour assurer la mise en oeuvre
- Suivre systématiquement les mesures d'amélioration et garantir des résultats durables en utilisant des indicateurs clairs
- Soutenir la numérisation des éléments maigres en introduisant des solutions visuelles et data-basées (p. ex. tableaux de bord numériques)
- Promouvoir activement une culture de l'amélioration continue par la formation, la formation et la mise en œuvre pratique sur le lieu de travail
- Effectuer la mise en œuvre du système de production Stryker (SPS) et assurer l'application durable des outils et méthodes maigres par la formation, le coaching et le soutien.
- Agir en tant que représentant du gestionnaire Lean et prendre en charge la gestion professionnelle et la coordination des activités d'amélioration maigre et continue si nécessaire.

C'est ce qui te fait ressentir
Titres requis

- Diplôme en génie mécanique, génie industriel, génie de la fabrication, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, gestion des processus et informatique d'affaires (HF) ou FH (maîtrise ou baccalauréat)
- Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans la planification et la mise en œuvre de projets maigres dans l'environnement de production
- Détection des méthodes maigres (par exemple analyse des flux de valeur, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, TPM, PDCA)
- Expérience dans l'utilisation de MS65, Power Automate et Power BI
- Allemand au niveau natif
- Anglais au niveau des négociations

Titres de compétence privilégiés

- Certification de gestion des processus ou des amortissements (p. ex., gestion des coûts, ceinture verte de six sigium ou ceinture jaune)
- Expérience de la visualisation numérique et des outils de collaboration (p. ex. Miro)
- Connaissances en conception de la disposition et analyse du flux de matériaux

Informations complémentaires

- Lieu de travail: Environnement de production dans l'usine
- Coopération étroite avec les équipes interfonctionnelles (production, qualité, ingénierie, logistique)
- Opérations transversales occasionnelles et participation possible aux audits

Cette position offre l'occasion de façonner des changements durables et de stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle de façon mesurable, avec un impact direct sur la performance de l'ensemble de l'emplacement.

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite

Purpose

• Development and execution of the EHS strategy for the Selzach site with the longterm objective to achieve "Zero Accidents"

• Contact Person/SME for EHS for the locations Selzach (incl. apprentice shop)

• Liason with Corporate EHS to assure site compliance with strategy and expectations

Key responsibilties

• Definition of EHS Goals and Objectives for the Selzach site

• Alignment of local EHS strategy with Corporate EHS strategy as well as Corporate Goals and Objectives

• Sicherheitsbeauftragter and Gefahrgutbeauftragter for the site and related buildings/operations incl. apprentice shop

• Management of relationship with critical contractors e.g. Neosys

• Assurance of local compliance with regulatory requirement related to EHS.

• Maintenance of the Selzach certification status and integrated management system related to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. Assurance of accuracy and completeness of risk management documentation. Continuous improvement and adaptation of the EHS Management System

• Educate, train and collaborate with the local Facility Services provider to assure compliance with the EHS management system requirements and contiuously improvement of facility services in relation to EHS

• Point of contact to the local public authorities e.g. Kantonales Amt für Umwelt, SUVA etc. Annual Reporting to the cantonal Amt für Umwelt Solothurn (Environmental protection certification) as part of the "Kollaborationsvereinbarung"

Qualifications

• Technical background with advanced Education in Industrial Engineering, building service engineering or mechanical engineering

• Knowledge in Facility Management

• Knowledge and training in safety aspects ("Sicherheitsbeauftragter")

• Fluent in German and English

• 5 -10 years relevant work experience

• Knowhow and experience in EHS Management Systems

• Self-motivated/self-starter and ability to work independently or in teams

• Service oriented attitude combined with innovative thinking

• Business minded, change orientated and pro-active personality

• Diplomatic, tactful and approachable; capable of navigating in a Corporate environment in terms of communication, escalations etc.

We have signed the Diversity Charter and are proud to be part of this initiative to promote diversity in the workplace. Because diversity is important to us!
We welcome applications from people regardless of their ethnic, national, or social background, gender, disability, age, or sexual identity.

• Switzerland : CHF114,000 - CHF189,900 CHF Annual

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Field-based

What You Will Do

As part of our Mako team, you will provide hands-on clinical and technical support to surgeons and operating room teams across Western Switzerland .
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Training and supporting surgeons and OR staff before and during procedures using the Mako System.

• Providing clinical and technical guidance on Mako and its applications for partial knee, total knee and total hip arthroplasty .

• Supporting surgeons with pre-operative planning , including the preparation and use of CT data within the Mako software.

• Planning and coordinating upcoming Mako procedures.

• Organizing and delivering training sessions and presentations for healthcare professionals in surgery and radiology .

• Supporting the onboarding and coordination of new customers in close collaboration with our Joint Replacement sales team .

• Providing product expertise and sales support at conferences, congresses and trade fairs .

What You Need
Required

• A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in a medical or clinical environment , such as operating room technology, medical technology/application support, clinical support or physiotherapy.

• Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex topics quickly and communicate them clearly.

• A strong customer and service mindset .

• Excellent organizational and planning skills, with a reliable and proactive approach.

• A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel extensively.

• Fluent in English and French skills at C1 level , both spoken and written. German language skills would be a plus.
Preferred

• A degree in Medical Engineering, Bioengineering, Natural Sciences or a comparable field.

• Previous experience working in an operating room environment .

Additional Information
We value diversity and welcome applications from people regardless of ethnic, national or social background, gender, disability, age or sexual identity.

What to Expect

• Comprehensive Mako product training , followed by an assessment and ongoing certifications, all conducted in English .

• A company car , also available for private use.

• Travel of up to 80% , primarily by company car, to support customers and procedures across the region. Occasional overnight stays will be required.

• Depending on your weekly schedule, you can spend the remaining time working from home .

Your salary level will be determined based on the depth and relevance of your professional experience .
